description: Retrieves a paginated list of published styles (fill colors, text styles, effects, grids) from a specified Figma team's library. Note: The team must have published styles in its library for this endpoint to return data. Teams without published styles will return an empty list.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving a paginated list of published styles for a Figma team.

after.description: Opaque integer cursor to retrieve styles after this point; use `cursor.after` from a previous response. Mutually exclusive with `before` - only one can be specified.
after.title: After

before.description: Opaque integer cursor to retrieve styles before this point; use `cursor.before` from a previous response. Mutually exclusive with `after` - only one can be specified.
before.title: Before

page_size.description: Number of style items to return per page. Maximum supported value is 100.
page_size.title: Page Size

team_id.description: Identifier of the Figma team to retrieve published styles from. Note: The team_id cannot be obtained programmatically via the API. To find a team_id, navigate to the team page in Figma (https://www.figma.com/files/team/YOUR_TEAM_ID/Team-Name) and extract the numeric ID from the URL.
team_id.title: Team Id

inputSchema.title: GetTeamStylesRequest

name: get_team_styles

after.description: Opaque cursor value for the `after` parameter to retrieve the next page of results. Null if no next page.
after.title: After

before.description: Opaque cursor value for the `before` parameter to retrieve the previous page of results. Null if no previous page.
before.title: Before

GetTeamStylesResponse.description: Response schema for `GetTeamStyles`, containing the list of styles and pagination details.

data.description: The main container for the response, including status, error indication, and the metadata which holds the styles and pagination cursors.
data.title: Data

GetTeamStylesResponse.title: GetTeamStylesResponse

cursor.description: Pagination cursors for navigating the list of styles.
cursor.title: Cursor

styles.description: List of style objects retrieved for the current page.
styles.title: Styles

error.description: Indicates if an error occurred. For successful requests, this value is `false`.
error.title: Error

meta.description: Contains the core response data, including the list of styles and pagination cursors.
meta.title: Meta

status.description: HTTP status code of the response. A value of 200 indicates success.
status.title: Status

created_at.description: Timestamp in UTC ISO 8601 format indicating when the style was created.
created_at.title: Created At

description.description: Description of the style, as provided by its publisher.
description.title: Description

file_key.description: Identifier of the Figma file where this style is defined and published.
file_key.title: File Key

key.description: The unique identifier (key) for the style.
key.title: Key

node_id.description: Identifier of the specific node within the Figma file that defines this style.
node_id.title: Node Id

sort_position.description: A user-specified string, often numerical, used for ordering or sorting styles.
sort_position.title: Sort Position

style_type.description: Type of the style, indicating what properties it defines (e.g., FILL, TEXT, EFFECT, GRID).
style_type.title: Style Type

thumbnail_url.description: URL for a thumbnail image preview of the style, if available.
thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url

updated_at.description: Timestamp in UTC ISO 8601 format indicating when the style was last updated.

user.description: Information about the user who created or last updated the style.
